definitions.explanation: The act of leaving one's home or workplace to go somewhere.

notes:
{外出|がいしゅつ} means going out or leaving home. It is commonly used in formal and official contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go out)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (out, away from home/office)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (going out prohibited)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination when out)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (permission to go out)

USAGE:
- More formal than ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to go out)
- Often used in workplace, hospital, or official contexts
- {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ is a common sign/status

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: more casual 'to go out'
- ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: general 'to go out, to leave'
